method: At each Y plane, intersect every head+cap triangle edge and select minimum/maximum X over every Z. Includes coplanar-Y edge endpoints. No convex hull, smoothing, circle or ellipse fit is used for measured envelopes.
source_ear_exclusion: Conservatively exclude every head triangle incident to a vertex in head_visible_source_ear; preserved v7 earback refinements retain this provenance. Non-ear data is diagnostic, not a changed model.
limits: Fixed-Z horizontal bow metrics cannot guarantee a convex top projection because the winning Z changes along Y.
The complete top outline includes a deliberate projecting ear. Its adjacent valley must not be conflated with a new isolated skull bump.
Ear-excluded contour still can have an S-shaped transition from locked original face/forehead to rounded rear skull.
The fixed cap is included at its exported design-gap position; these silhouette metrics are not assembly or collision tests.

full_ear_to_posterior_waist.definition: Largest anterior width in Y−1..1.5 and posterior width in Y3..10; minimum width between them. Includes the conserved ear silhouette.

ear_excluded_chord.definition: Signed |X|max(Y) minus endpoint chord; negative denotes an inward S-shaped connector relative to that chord, even if the width is monotonically increasing.
